label: EX2300-24P PoE+ 24-port 1G access switch
description: Juniper EX2300-24P 1RU PoE+ access switch: 24x 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ-45, all 24 PSE ports at 802.3af/802.3at up to 30 W each on a 370 W budget, 4x 1G/10G SFP/SFP+ uplinks (xe-0/1/0-3), 1x RJ-45 out-of-band management port, RJ-45 serial and mini-USB Type B console, 128 Gbps packet-switching capacity, 95 Mpps, 80 W input power with no PoE load, 450 W fixed supply, image 15.1X53-D50 or later.

poe.note: 370 W available for PoE from a 450 W fixed supply - the system-overview table, the power-supply table and the datasheet all quote 370 W. All 24 RJ-45 ports are PSE ports, so 12 x 30 W PoE+ plus 12 x 15.4 W af fits inside the budget and 24 x 30 W (720 W) does not. IEEE 802.3af (15.4 W) and 802.3at (30 W) only: no 802.3bt on any EX2300.

fabric.note: 128 Gbps bidirectional, 95 Mpps, from the datasheet's 24-port group and the per-model hardware specs. The 370 W in the per-model 'AC Max Power Consumption' row is the whole box with PoE at full budget, not the PoE budget itself - the no-PoE figure is 80 W.

notes: 24 PoE+ RJ-45 access ports, 4 SFP+ uplinks, 2 console ports (RJ-45 + mini-USB), 1 RJ-45 management port, 1 USB Type A. 12.2 in / 30.98 cm deep (deeper than the T because of the 450 W supply), 4.49 kg, two fixed front-to-back fans, 40.6 dB. The PSE allocates by class, so 24 x 30 W will not be granted on a 370 W budget.
